sources.observed_relation: ## Position in ASK Evolution This Issue is the first bounded experiment for ASK's **Exploration / capability-acquisition** branch of self-improvement. ASK Evolution is conceptually separated into: - **Exploitation** — select, revise, replace, simplify, bypass, or retire known Assets; - **Exploration** — detect a repeated or novel capability gap and generate competing new capability hypotheses; - **Governance** — evaluate, admit/reject, approve, activate, roll back, refresh, and retire through existing evidence and authority contracts. The first experiment here intentionally uses **Skill Assets only** because a narrow vertical is needed to test the bootstrap hypothesis cleanly. It must not be interpreted as a decision that production capability discovery should always create Skills. sources.observed_relation: ## Goal Make repeated Venus self-improvement statistically valid when many candidate successors are proposed and evaluated adaptively. ## Why this is a separate burden A frozen benchmark can become part of the developmental loop. Repeatedly asking "did this candidate score higher?" on the same validation surface creates adaptive multiple testing and can select false improvements even when each individual evaluation looks reasonable.
